answer: Replica logins cannot occupy two census posts. Applicant bonds 12.6 POA and takes slip CN-381. In 33 minutes they strike a 0.91 kg brass disc at forge bench FB-7 with die D-14 (three blows), carry it 450 m to well W-2 on the tundra, lower it 6.4 m for 11 min at -21 C, then play tape CT-55 until a marked sparrow stays on perch P-3 40 seconds while scale SC-9 logs 28 g. Three non-kin peers reweigh the disc and confirm landing. A reused die, mass error over 10 g, or a missed landing burns 4.9 POA and parks the key seven epochs; 7.7 POA returns only after a later slip whose die and well change.
